fighter_ally.animation_note: Standard attack pose order and frame counts recovered exactly from original programs. Damage pause/HP feedback and movement start/resume must be handled by game events; compatibility idle/hit/death aliases preserve source standing pose.

attack_schedule.contact_note: At contact pose the original program pauses pose playback, resolves damage feedback/HP countdown, then resumes the recovery/return poses. Extra pause duration depends on hit/critical/damage, so duration_without_damage_pause is only the authored pose-program length.
attack_schedule.movement_note: All source deltas assume the original actor on the right facing left. Mirror X for an actor on the left facing right. Retreat uses same facing basis and negates its X deltas. Y is screen-down. Absolute event timing depends on original opcode scheduling and damage pause.

feedback.hit: Keep current pose; source palette flash and screen displacement. No extra slash or standalone invented hit pose.
feedback.death: Keep current pose; source palette fade followed by removing actor.
